name: Product Description Generator
description: Triggered when a new product is added to the catalog, this workflow simultaneously generates optimized descriptions for three channels: the company website, marketplace listings (e.g., Shopee/Amazon), and social media (Instagram). After the content team approves the drafts, they are saved to the product database and a notification is sent. Ideal for e-commerce teams managing multi-channel product content at scale.

config.prompt:
Write a detailed product description for the company website (150-200 words).
Use the following product details:
{{input}}

Guidelines:
- Lead with the primary benefit, not the feature
- Include 3-4 key features with brief explanations
- Mention the ideal use case or target user
- End with a clear call-to-action
- Tone: professional yet approachable
- Do NOT include pricing

Write a marketplace product listing optimized for Shopee/Amazon.
Product details: {{input}}

Format:
- Title: Under 200 characters, keyword-rich
- 5 bullet points highlighting key features
- Short description (under 100 words)

Optimize for:
- Mobile readability
- Search keywords relevant to {{category}}
- Conversion-focused language

Write an engaging Instagram caption for a new product post.
Product details: {{input}}

Requirements:
- Caption: Under 125 words, conversational and enthusiastic
- Include a question to drive engagement
- Add 10-15 relevant hashtags
- Include one emoji per sentence maximum
- End with a call-to-action (link in bio, shop now, etc.)

config.message: New product descriptions ready for review: {{productName}}. Please review website, marketplace, and social media drafts.

data.label: Save approved descriptions to product table

config.query: UPDATE products SET website_description = '{{websiteDesc}}', marketplace_description = '{{marketplaceDesc}}', social_caption = '{{socialCaption}}', descriptions_approved_at = NOW() WHERE id = '{{productId}}'

config.message: Product descriptions approved and saved for {{productName}} (ID: {{productId}}). Ready to publish across all channels.
